Attached is an initial mutual action plan to annotate (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) and a short draft agenda. Please:
- Confirm which QBR slot works for you and Tom.
- Share any procurement constraints or approver names we should include on the invite.
- If BrightPath prefers a different term length, tell us why and we can model pricing.

Next steps (internal + external):
1) BrightPath to confirm QBR slot and add procurement contact (Tom) — Alicia
2) Redwood to send calendar invite, QBR agenda, and updated pricing snapshot — Vanessa/Rishi
3) CS to prepare usage delta runbook and provisioning checklist — Marissa
